sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 王一雪：小雪，你们的话剧排好了吗？
blocks.en: Wang Yixue: Xiaoxue, have you finished rehearsing your play?

blocks.zh: 刘小雪：差不多了，妈妈。艺术节周五下午开始，我内心还是有些紧张，有时候不是忘词，就是忘记做动作。
blocks.en: Liu Xiaoxue: Almost, Mum. The arts festival begins on Friday afternoon. I still feel nervous; sometimes I forget either my lines or my movements.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：没事，妈妈相信你一定可以。放松些，再自信些！
blocks.en: Wang: It is all right. I believe you can do it. Relax and be more confident!

blocks.zh: 刘小雪：好的，我同学演少年歌手，他的歌声美极了。我演他的妈妈，不知道像不像呢。
blocks.en: Xiaoxue: All right. My classmate plays a young singer, and his voice is beautiful. I play his mother. I wonder whether I look convincing.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：没问题的，努力做最好的自己就好。演出时，我和你爸都去给你加油。
blocks.en: Wang: You will be fine. Just try to be your best self. Your dad and I will both come to support you.

blocks.zh: 刘小雪：好的，谢谢妈妈！
blocks.en: Xiaoxue: Great, thank you, Mum!

blocks.zh: 小雪紧张时会怎么样？
blocks.en: What happens when Xiaoxue is nervous?

answers.zh: 她有时候不是忘词，就是忘记做动作。
answers.en: She sometimes forgets either her lines or her movements.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 小雪演出时，妈妈和爸爸会去看吗？
blocks.en: Will her parents attend her performance?

answers.zh: 会，他们都会去给她加油。
answers.en: Yes, they will both go to support her.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 王一雪问小雪他们的……。小雪说……，艺术节……开始，她现在……，有时候不是……，就是……。王一雪鼓励小雪，……，再……。小雪说，她的同学演……，同学的歌声……。她演妈妈，不知道……。王一雪继续鼓励小雪，努力……。演出时，她和小雪的爸爸都……。
prompt.en: Wang asks about their…. Xiaoxue says …; the festival starts …, and she feels…. Sometimes she either … or…. Wang encourages her to … and be…. Her classmate plays … and sings…. She plays the mother and wonders…. Wang tells her to try…. Both parents will….

answer.zh: 王一雪问小雪他们的话剧排好了吗。小雪说差不多了，艺术节周五下午开始，她还有些紧张，有时候不是忘词，就是忘记做动作。王一雪让她放松些，再自信些。小雪的同学演少年歌手，歌声美极了。她演妈妈，不知道像不像。王一雪鼓励她努力做最好的自己。演出时，爸爸妈妈都会去给她加油。
answer.en: Wang asks whether the play is ready. Xiaoxue says it is almost ready for Friday afternoon, but she is nervous and forgets lines or movements. Wang tells her to relax and be confident. Her classmate plays a young singer beautifully; she wonders whether she is convincing as his mother. Wang encourages her to do her best. Both parents will support her.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 李文：下周六晚上，我请大家去国家大剧院看京剧，怎么样？
blocks.en: Li Wen: How about I take everyone to see Peking Opera at the National Centre for the Performing Arts next Saturday evening?

blocks.zh: 安妮：好啊。我小时候在加拿大度假时，在宾馆的电视上看过一次，是梅兰芳等演员演的，演员们都非常棒，他们演唱得好听极了，给我留下的印象特别深。
blocks.en: Annie: Great. As a child on holiday in Canada, I watched it on the hotel television. Mei Lanfang and other performers were excellent. Their beautiful singing left a deep impression.

blocks.zh: 李文：梅兰芳先生是中国著名京剧艺术家。咱们要看的这个京剧是青年演员们演的，要去看的观众也特别多。
blocks.en: Li: Mei Lanfang is a famous Chinese Peking Opera artist. Our performance features young actors and has a large audience.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：不知道我们能不能看懂。
blocks.en: Chen Tianzhong: I wonder whether we will understand it.

blocks.zh: 白家月：咱们先做做功课，提前了解下，能懂一点儿是一点儿。
blocks.en: Bai Jiayue: Let us prepare and learn about it beforehand. We should understand as much as we can.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：对，我先去网上查资料，查完后也转发给你们。
blocks.en: Chen: Right. I will look up information online and forward it to you.

blocks.zh: 安妮：谢谢天中！
blocks.en: Annie: Thanks, Tianzhong!

blocks.zh: 李文：那我就在网上订票了，到时候咱们在大剧院入口见。
blocks.en: Li: Then I will book online. We will meet at the theatre entrance.

blocks.zh: 在加拿大时安妮就看过京剧，她觉得怎么样？
blocks.en: What did Annie think of the Peking Opera she saw in Canada?

answers.zh: 演员非常棒，演唱很好听，给她留下了很深的印象。
answers.en: The performers and singing were excellent and left a deep impression.

blocks.zh: 咱们先做做功课，提前了解下，能懂一点儿是一点儿。
blocks.en: Let us prepare beforehand and understand as much as we can.

blocks.zh: 虽然这本书很厚，但是我还是要看，看一页是一页，最后一定能看完。
blocks.en: Although the book is thick, I will read it a page at a time until I finish.

blocks.zh: 你能多吃一点儿是一点儿，这样身体才能好起来。

blocks.zh: A：我们____，最后一定都能学会。B：是的，现在就开始吧。

answers.en: We should learn as much as we can.

blocks.heading: Book practice · 1

blocks.zh: A：事情实在太多了，你能做完吗？B：慢慢做，____。
blocks.en: There is so much to do. Can you finish? Work gradually,….

answers.en: Do one thing at a time, as much as possible.

answers.en: Solve as many as possible, one at a time.

sections.intro: Verb + 一×是一× means doing as much as possible under the circumstances.

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 周六晚上，李文等四人来到国家大剧院观看京剧演出。入座后，李文指着节目表说：“这些演员很专业，功夫很深，在京剧比赛中获过很多奖，有的还是国家、国际大奖。我特别期待这场演出。”
blocks.en: On Saturday evening, Li Wen and his three friends went to the National Centre for the Performing Arts to watch Peking Opera. After sitting down, Li pointed at the programme: “These actors are professional and highly skilled. They have won many prizes, including national and international awards. I am really looking forward to this.”

blocks.zh: 演出开始后，他们看到演员们做的动作很难，但是做得都特别好，观众们不断鼓掌。因为李文他们提前把故事了解了一遍，所以差不多都看懂了。演出结束后，演员们邀请观众和他们一起庆祝演出成功。
blocks.en: The movements were difficult, but the actors performed them very well, and the audience applauded repeatedly. Since Li and his friends had familiarised themselves with the story, they understood almost everything. Afterwards the actors invited the audience to celebrate the success with them.

blocks.zh: 回来的路上，大家特别激动，觉得京剧很有意思，演员演得很精彩。李文点头说：“是啊，以后咱们还来看。”
blocks.en: On the way home everyone was excited. They found Peking Opera interesting and the acting wonderful. Li nodded: “Yes, let us come again.”

blocks.zh: 京剧演员们的表演怎么样？
blocks.en: How was the opera performance?

answers.zh: 动作很难，但是演员做得特别好，表演很精彩。
answers.en: The movements were difficult, but the actors performed them beautifully.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 李文为什么说以后还来看京剧演出？
blocks.en: Why does Li want to see Peking Opera again?

answers.zh: 因为京剧很有意思，演员演得很精彩。
answers.en: Because it is interesting and the performers are excellent.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 周六晚上，李文等四人来到国家大剧院……。入座后，李文……说：“这些演员很专业，……，在京剧比赛中……，有的还是……。”演出开始后，他们看到演员们做的动作……，但是做得……，观众们……。因为李文他们提前……，所以差不多……。演出……，演员们邀请观众……。回来的路上，大家……，觉得……，演员……。李文点头说：“以后……。”
prompt.en: The four friends went to the theatre to…. Li … and said the actors were professional, … and had won…. The movements were … but performed …; the audience…. They had prepared …, so…. After …, the actors invited…. On the way home everyone …; Li said they would….

answer.zh: 周六晚上，李文等四人来到国家大剧院看京剧。李文指着节目表说演员很专业，功夫很深，获过很多国家、国际大奖。演员的动作很难，但做得特别好，观众不断鼓掌。因为他们提前了解了故事，所以差不多都看懂了。演出后，演员邀请大家庆祝演出成功。回来的路上，他们很激动，觉得京剧有意思，演员演得精彩，以后还想再来。
answer.en: The four friends watched Peking Opera. Li pointed out the professional actors’ skill and awards. They performed difficult movements wonderfully, earning applause. The friends understood because they had prepared the story. Afterwards they celebrated with the actors. They enjoyed it greatly and wanted to return.

sections.title: Grammar 3 · 把＋宾语＋动词＋动量补语

blocks.zh: 因为李文他们提前把故事了解了一遍，所以差不多都看懂了。
blocks.en: Since they had studied the story once beforehand, they understood almost everything.

blocks.zh: 他把这个动作做了好几次，最后终于做对了。
blocks.en: He repeated the movement several times and finally got it right.

blocks.zh: 白家月又把这本书看了几遍，越看越喜欢。
blocks.en: Bai reread the book several times and liked it more each time.

blocks.zh: 他们小组特别认真，____，最后才定下来。（讨论）
blocks.en: Their group was careful; they … before deciding. Use 讨论.

answers.zh: 他们把这个问题讨论了三遍
answers.en: They discussed the issue three times.

blocks.zh: 我____，还是不满意。（计划书）
blocks.en: I … but am still dissatisfied. Use 计划书.

answers.en: I revised the plan several times.

blocks.heading: Book practice · 2

blocks.zh: 我们____，最后所有人都记住了。（排）
blocks.en: We … until everyone remembered. Use 排.

answers.en: We rehearsed the programme five times.

blocks.heading: Book practice · 3

sections.intro: 把 + object + verb + frequency complement states how many times an action is performed on the object.

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: 马可·波罗是意大利旅行家，在1275年和家人来到中国，在中国大约生活了17年，最后完成了一部作品——《马可·波罗游记》。在这部影响很大的作品中，作者向世界介绍了13世纪时的中国。
blocks.en: Marco Polo was an Italian traveller who came to China with his family in 1275 and lived there for about seventeen years. He eventually completed The Travels of Marco Polo, an influential work introducing thirteenth-century China to the world.

blocks.zh: 作为读者，读完这部作品后，我也很想成为作家，更想来中国看看。来到中国后，我发现现在的中国和书里的中国已有很大不同。
blocks.en: After reading it, I wanted to become a writer and especially to visit China. When I arrived, I found modern China very different from the China in the book.

blocks.zh: 前两天，我去书店看到了中文版的《马可·波罗游记》，马上买了一本，到家后又把这本书看了两天。看完后，我决定把自己来中国后写的文章、日记等全部整理出来，完成一部文字加图片的作品——《东方旅行日记》，再次把中国介绍给世界。同时我也想继续学习中文和中国文化，报考中国语言文学专业的研究生。
blocks.en: Two days ago I saw the Chinese edition in a bookshop and bought it immediately. At home I read it for two more days. I decided to organise all my articles and diaries from China into an illustrated work, Travel Diary of the East, to introduce China to the world again. I also want to keep studying Chinese language and culture and apply for postgraduate studies in Chinese language and literature.

blocks.zh: 马可·波罗写的游记怎么样？
blocks.en: What is Marco Polo’s travel book like?

answers.zh: 这是一部影响很大的作品，介绍了13世纪的中国。
answers.en: It is an influential work describing thirteenth-century China.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 来到中国后，白家月有什么发现？她后来决定读什么专业？
blocks.en: What did Bai discover in China, and what subject did she choose?

answers.zh: 现在的中国和书里很不一样。她决定报考中国语言文学专业的研究生。
answers.en: China today differs greatly from the book. She decided to apply for postgraduate Chinese language and literature.

answers.zh: 我把它们整理了半个小时

blocks.heading: Book practice · 1

blocks.heading: Performance
blocks.zh: 三至五人一组，选择一个与本课话题有关的主题，排一个五分钟左右的小节目，可以是小话剧、对话表演、朗诵等。每位同学都要参加，并尽量使用本课学过的词语和语言点。排完后在全班进行表演。
blocks.en: In groups of three to five, prepare a roughly five-minute play, dialogue or recitation related to this lesson. Everyone should participate and use the lesson’s language. Perform for the class.

blocks.heading: Writing · at least 140 characters
blocks.zh: 请介绍一部你喜欢的小说，描述一下主要故事情节，不少于140字。
blocks.en: Introduce a novel you like and describe its main plot in at least 140 Chinese characters.

answers.zh: 我喜欢的小说是《西游记》。这部作品讲的是唐僧和三个学生去很远的地方取经的故事。他们一路上遇到了很多困难，有时候走错路，有时候遇到危险，但是大家没有放弃。孙悟空很勇敢，也很聪明，总能想办法帮助大家。其他人虽然有不同的性格，但最后学会了互相帮助。我把这本书看了好几遍，每次都有新的感受。我最喜欢的不是打斗的场面，而是朋友之间的感情。这部小说让我明白，一个人有能力很重要，和别人合作也很重要。只要坚持努力，困难就有可能解决。
answers.en: My favourite novel is Journey to the West. It follows Tang Sanzang and his three companions on a long journey to obtain scriptures. They face many difficulties but do not give up. Sun Wukong is brave and clever, and the companions learn to help one another. I have reread it several times. I enjoy the friendships most. It teaches me the value of ability, cooperation and persistence.
